description: Value-form `${ if @a {"A"} // note⏎ else {"B"} }`: the comment between `}` and `else` is whitespace; with `@a` false the value is "B". Round 3 accepted this; round 4 rejected it; base failed E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC.
rationale: JS and scrml treat a comment between an `if` body's `}` and `else` as whitespace; only a `;` ends the `if` (S437 round 4 #4). §17: `else` belongs to the `if` whose body it follows.
